start.name: MAYOR
start.text: Oh — a visitor! You must be the adventurer everyone's talking about.

quest_branch.name: MAYOR
quest_branch.text: How can I help you today?

choices.text: Did you say... slimes? Tell me more. (in progress)

intro_quest.name: MAYOR
intro_quest.text: Slimes have infested the cellar of the tavern. Please, you have to help us!

accept_quest.name: MAYOR
accept_quest.text: Thank you! Go defeat 3 slimes in the cellar, then come back to me.

in_progress_reminder.name: MAYOR
in_progress_reminder.text: The cellar is just east of the tavern. Come back when the slimes are dealt with.

complete_quest.name: MAYOR
complete_quest.text: Incredible! The cellar is slime-free at last. Thank you, truly — you've saved our tavern.

after_complete.name: MAYOR
after_complete.text: If you ever need a warm meal, it's on the house. Farewell, hero!
